'''Kaguya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kaguya participated in a discussion on the nature of the benefits and problems caused to Cularin by the world's [[Platform city|platform cities]]. Kaguya argued that the platform cities encroached on Tarasin land and were detrimental to the Cularin ecosystem. However, the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Mirt]] disagreed with her views, causing the pair to starting insulting each other.
